bibl.title: Demotic Literary Texts from Tebtunis and Beyond
bibl.seg: Kim Ryholt (ed.), with contributions by Joachim Friedrich Quack & K.R., Demotic Literary Texts from Tebtunis and Beyond = The Carlsberg Papyri. 11 = CNI Publications. 36.
Copenhagen, Museum Tusculanum Press, 2019, xiv-535 pp. en 2 voll., figg. ISBN 978-87-635-2607-4. 750 cour. dan.
bibl.note: Contains a wide selection of demotic texts from the Tebtunis temple library. - Religious Literature (1-9). - Divination (10-30). - Astronomy (31). - Medicine (32). - Ethnography (33). - Onomastica (34-38). - Wisdom Literature (39-45). - Narratives (46-49).
